title: Resurfacing the playground on Elder Street
story: The playground behind the community hall has not been touched in eleven years. The rubber surface has split, two of the swings are chained up, and the older children have nowhere to go after school. Our residents association has quotes from three contractors and we are raising 18,000 GBP to resurface the play area, replace the swings and plant a row of trees along the fence. Everyone on the street is welcome to use it and always has been. Local businesses have offered to match the first 3,000 GBP.
reviewerNote: Declined for the zakat badge. There is no beneficiary in material need named anywhere in the copy, nothing is transferred to a person, and the amenity serves a mixed neighbourhood on the same terms it always has. Nothing in the text engages any of the eight categories, so there was no contested question to route anywhere. I wrote to the organizer the same day to say the campaign itself is unaffected and can keep raising as a general donation campaign, which is where its matched funding is coming from anyway.
